replaces.idea: A tall cast-iron finned radiator standing on four legs with a side valve wheel, representing thermal radiation of dissipated heat.
A brass-framed partition box with a hinged sliding trapdoor, representing Maxwell's demon sorting molecules and paying the entropy cost.
A horizontal piston cylinder on a pedestal with a hanging pulley weight, representing a Szilard engine converting one bit into work.
A hinged accordion bellows standing on its nozzle base, representing phase-space compression during irreversible bit erasure.
A bulb thermometer mounted on a metal backing plate, representing the kT ln 2 waste heat of computation.

new.name: kT Thermometer
new.depicts: A glass bulb thermometer mounted on a small metal backing plate, with a dark-navy column rising from a round lower bulb.
new.focal: The bright cyan-white meniscus at the top of the thermometer column.

new.name: Phase Bellows
new.depicts: A hinged wooden-and-leather hand bellows standing upright on its flat nozzle base, with pleated accordion ribs and two handles.
new.focal: The pinched accordion pleats of the bellows.

new.name: Demon's Trapdoor
new.depicts: A tiny brass-framed partition box standing on two feet, with a hinged sliding trapdoor in the middle and a small knob on top.
new.focal: The half-open sliding trapdoor in the partition.

new.name: Szilard Cylinder
new.depicts: A horizontal glass-walled piston cylinder mounted on a heavy pedestal, with a central dividing piston and a small hanging weight on a pulley cord.
new.focal: The suspended weight hanging from the side pulley.

new.name: Fin Radiator
new.depicts: A tall cast-iron finned radiator standing on four stubby legs, with six vertical ribbed columns joined by top and bottom manifolds and a side valve wheel.
new.focal: The glowing pale-cyan valve wheel on the side pipe.

new.name: Ballistic Pendulum
new.depicts: A miniature brass A-frame stand resting on a flat base, suspending a single round bob on a vertical rod.
new.focal: The round bob hanging at the bottom of the rod.

new.name: Bomb Calorimeter
new.depicts: A stout cylindrical metal vessel with a bolted lid, two side handles, and a short stubby dial gauge protruding from the top.
new.focal: The bolted flange rim around the lid.
